lineage.strategy: Acquire current issuer Q2 operating and guidance facts absent from the sparse prior Scout lineage.

observations.fact: Q2 revenue was $508M versus $506M a year earlier; six-month revenue was $1.066B versus $944M.
Q2 GAAP gross margin fell to 46% from 50%, while adjusted gross margin fell to 66% from 69%; Mobileye attributed pressure partly to lower EyeQ ASP and a higher SuperVision hardware mix.
Six-month operating cash flow was $210M and cash/securities/deposits were $1.4B.
Updated 2026 revenue guidance is $1.970B-$2.020B; adjusted operating income guidance rose to $365M-$425M, with the revision materially aided by an Israeli R&D incentive grant.

risks.risk: Margin improvement in adjusted operating income is partly policy-incentive driven rather than purely operating leverage, while core Q2 revenue was flat year over year.

contradictions.contradiction: Management describes strong core momentum while Q2 revenue was essentially flat and gross margin declined; the six-month growth and future product launches need to be separated from current-quarter economics.

unknowns.unknown: Revenue conversion timing and economics for robotaxi/advanced-product pipeline remain unproven in this release.

recommendation: Use current revenue, margin, cash-flow and guidance facts as source-addressed underwriting inputs; normalize incentive effects before numeric scoring.
